execution.base: Every case starts from completeChain canonical JSON values.
execution.mutations: mutations and postMutations are RFC 6902 add, remove, or replace operations with an additional target selecting root, certificate, manifest, or context.
execution.resign: resign deterministically signs named objects after mutations with completeChain seeds or inputs.issuerSeed.
execution.expected: Each case invokes operation through the public protocol API and compares valid, code, path, and the optional output subset.
